'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Casper LS Yavin 4''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casper]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Casper]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
